outputs.DETERMINISM_NOTES: No test-name, hidden-input or environment-specific branching is used. Fixed compressed source overlays are applied deterministically, formatted, tested with go test ./..., and built from the registered command entrypoint.
outputs.PRESERVED_BEHAVIOR: The public serve/validate CLI, JSON configuration schema, operator configuration/discovery APIs, HTTP data plane, health/status/readiness/metrics/events surfaces, routing policies and durable state directory remain intact.
outputs.RESTART_IDEMPOTENCY_BEHAVIOR: The deterministic solution overlay reconstructs the same repaired runtime from the same payload and Q5 overlays on repeated execution; restart recovery validates durable checkpoint authority before readiness and falls back to a previous complete generation when current recovery state is invalid.
RESTORED_INVARIANTS: Per-source revision and digest authority is fenced under serialized acceptance; rejected or conflicting updates do not alter accepted metadata.
Candidate validation, runtime reconciliation, checkpoint preparation, publication and acknowledgement preserve last-known-good serving state on rejection.
Serving publication exposes one complete immutable runtime snapshot and each request retains one snapshot lease across route selection, retry and failover.
Canonical endpoint identity and membership incarnation distinguish continuous reuse from accepted removal followed by re-add.
Affinity, balancing, retry and failover revalidate incarnation, lifecycle and health eligibility, with deterministic failure when no eligible backend remains.
Removed endpoints become ineligible for fresh generations while already-leased generations may complete bounded attempts against DRAINING endpoints; RETIRED endpoints remain forbidden.
Checkpoint bodies and CURRENT authority use durable ordering, integrity verification and previous-complete fallback on restart.
Lifecycle-scoped runtime, transport and telemetry state is retired when unreachable rather than growing without bound.
RISKS_FOR_INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER: Exercise same-revision/different-digest conflicts and rejected-update preservation independently.
Hold live requests across publication and verify generation-consistent retry and failover, including DRAINING completion for already-leased generations.
Cover canonical endpoint aliases, remove/re-add incarnation changes, draining/ineligible endpoints and all-down behavior.
Exercise restart around checkpoint publication, corrupt CURRENT and retained-previous fallback through public behavior.
Repeat update/remove/re-add cycles and verify transport, affinity and telemetry state remain bounded.
